approval_scope: Portrait opening composition and typography/micro-animation direction of scheme 1; not a new drawing-style baseline, universal story script, audio recast, full-film acceptance or publication authorization.
construction: Upper centered setup in rounded heavy type
Whole payoff block in narrow poster type with primary coral line and quieter cream line
Controlled ink-tone split and offset shadow; natural letter proportions
Whole-block entry and uniform 1.035-to-1 settle; one brief hand-drawn accent
Lower scene keeps face, compact white gloves, clock and emerging story-supported threat legible

source.treatment: Native portrait editorial recomposition of existing published artwork and original continuous mix; no new narration or generated artwork.

reuse_boundary: Use the composition, hierarchy, material finish and motion grammar. Do not copy the Death Clock characters, question, clock, menace or English glyph shapes into unrelated stories. New production requires story-specific native portrait artwork and semantic text in the chosen language.
